name: Konomi
source:
He enjoys pleasure and is highly adaptable. He has a laid-back nature and accepts things as they are. It may appear that he teases others knowingly, but he doesn't mean any harm.

He approaches both humans and other elves with a somewhat condescending attitude. As a result, he may seem elusive, but he is simply loyal to his own pleasure and desires.
